subject: mathematics
title: Grade 3 Mathematics — Set 2
description: More practice on multiplication, shapes, time, and measurement

questions.question: A clock shows 3:00. Which number does the hour hand point to?
questions.explanation: At 3:00 the hour hand points to 3 and the minute hand points to 12.

questions.question: How many sides does a pentagon have?
questions.explanation: A pentagon has 5 sides. "Penta" means five in Greek.

questions.question: Which is the smallest number: 312, 231, 321, 213?
questions.explanation: 213 < 231 < 312 < 321. Compare the tens digit when hundreds are equal.
